copy_policy: Byte-identical copies; originals retained. No raw native profiler traces, checkpoint weights, tokenizer bundles or source snapshots copied.

text_credential_scan.limits: Pattern-based scan is not a proof of absence of secrets. Binary files were not decoded; this archive contains selected text evidence only.

provenance_note: Absolute source paths are retained as historical metadata, not portable hyperlinks; use repository_relative_path to locate archived evidence.
